comment: Reset Cycles and Smart Randomize are on the cycle selector knob's own menu, not the panel menu, and the drawn value rows carry a menu of their own. RATE and SHAPE divide their voltage by an attenuverter range that is a menu choice of 5 or 10 (ArpSeq.hpp:1046-1053), so the span a full attenuverter covers is ±5V or ±10V depending on that setting. No range is written for either jack because it is not fixed.
